resources.string: Follow traffic rules and ensure student safety always.

• No Third-Party Sharing: We never sell or share your data with external advertisers or third parties.
 • Transport Only: Data is strictly used for transport operations, route optimization, and safety.
 • Encrypted Storage: All sensitive data is stored using industry-standard AES encryption.
 • Role-Based Access: Personnel can only access data relevant to their specific operational duties.
Collection includes full name, student ID, and daily boarding attendance logs for safety verification. Location tracking is enabled ONLY for active bus arrival monitoring.
We track assigned route schedules, vehicle identification numbers, and GPS coordinates (broadcast only during active duty hours). Trip logs and fuel stops are kept for operational analytics.

Administrators have full visibility for system management purposes including:
• User Management
• Analytics Dashboard
• Attendance Logs
• Fleet Management
High-level access is limited to Summary Reports. No individual personal data editing capabilities are granted to management accounts.

Our system respects your physical boundaries. Location tracking is strictly task-oriented:

• Active: During scheduled transit routes and pickup windows.
• Disabled: Tracking immediately stops when the trip is marked as "Completed" or "Duty Off".
By using this app, you agree to the following terms and conditions for institutional transportation management.

BusTrack is an institutional logistics platform specifically engineered for college transport management. This service is provided solely for the coordination of student and staff mobility within registered educational institutions. By accessing the platform, you acknowledge that the application is designed to optimize fleet operations and ensure the safety of transit within the designated academic ecosystem.

To provide accurate fleet management, BusTrack utilizes high-precision Global Positioning System (GPS) technology. You hereby grant permission for the application to access and monitor location data during active trips only. This tracking is essential for route optimization, estimated arrival times, and emergency response protocols. Location services are automatically suspended once a trip is marked as complete or the application is terminated in accordance with our power-saving logistics protocols.

Our platform leverages Google Firebase for robust user authentication and cloud storage services. This infrastructure ensures that your credentials and personal identifiers are stored in a secure, encrypted environment. We utilize industry-standard protocols to prevent unauthorized access to the database, ensuring that institutional data remains isolated and protected against external threats.

BusTrack integrates Google Maps APIs to provide detailed visual tracking and navigation. Your interaction with map elements is subject to both these Terms and Google\'s additional Terms of Service. This integration is strictly for the purpose of visual route representation and does not involve the permanent storage of your movement patterns beyond the operational requirements of the active academic term.

Secure attendance data is captured through the application to assist institution administrators in managing bus occupancy and rider safety. Admin control panels provide authorized personnel with oversight of fleet performance and rider logs. You agree that this data is the property of your respective institution and is managed under their specific internal governance and privacy policies.

Users are strictly prohibited from attempting any unauthorized access to the application\'s backend or interfering with the live data streams. Any attempt to reverse engineer the BusTrack software or bypass security layers will result in immediate termination of access and potential legal action by the institution. We maintain a zero-tolerance policy regarding third-party data sharing: your transit information will never be sold or distributed to external marketing entities.

While we strive for 99.9% uptime, BusTrack performance is dependent on external factors including cellular internet connectivity and GPS satellite availability. Service interruptions may occur due to network dead zones or atmospheric interference. BusTrack is not liable for delays or inaccuracies caused by hardware failure or third-party network outages that are outside of our direct operational control.

As institutional requirements evolve, we may update these Terms and Conditions periodically. Continued use of the application following any modifications constitutes your acceptance of the revised legal framework. We recommend reviewing this document regularly to stay informed about our data handling and operational security standards.

Documentation and resources for fleet administrators and logistics personnel.
How to reassign a driver mid-shift?
Navigate to the \'Live Map\' or \'Buses\' panel, select the active bus, and use the \'Reassign Driver\' option to update the current trip holder.
How to optimize route efficiency using Google Maps?
Access the \'Route Management\' panel. The system automatically suggests optimized paths based on real-time traffic data provided by Google Maps API.
How to manage student ID and bus assignments?
Use the \'User Management\' module to add new students and assign them to specific routes based on their residential sectors.
How to handle emergency breakdown alerts?
When a breakdown alert is received, the system notifies all affected parents. Administrators should immediately assign a backup vehicle from the \'Fleet\' tab.
How to sync daily attendance with the central database?
The sync occurs automatically at the end of each trip. Manual sync can be triggered from the \'Attendance Hub\' settings if needed.
How to add a temporary vehicle to an existing route?
Navigate to \'Fleet\' > \'Vehicles\' and add a secondary vehicle. Assign it to the desired route ID for the specified duration.
How to broadcast an emergency announcement to all parents?
Use the \'Emergency Broadcast\' tool in the \'Alerts\' section. Type your message and select \'Broadcast to All\' to reach parents instantly.
How to create a new route using Google Maps?
Navigate to \'Manage Routes\' and tap the \'+\' icon. Use the map interface to drop pins for stops, and the system will draw the path.
How to add or delete stops on a route?
Open any route in \'Route Details\'. To add a stop, tap \'Edit Points\'; to delete, swipe left on the stop name in the list.
Dedicated 24/7 technical assistance for system administrators and fleet dispatchers.
Everything you need to know about driving and managing your route.
How do I start navigation for my trip?
Ensure you are \'On Duty\', reach the starting point of your route, and tap the green \'Start Navigation\' button on your dashboard.
What should I do in case of a bus breakdown?
Tap the \'Alerts\' button and send a \'Breakdown\' notification immediately. The system will alert admins and parents on your route.
How do I mark student attendance?
Navigate to the \'Students\' tab or use the \'Daily Attendance\' option from the side menu to mark students as Present or Absent for each stop.
Check if GPS is enabled, ensure you are \'On Duty\', and verify that you are physically within the starting zone of your assigned route.
How to update my profile picture?
Go to the side menu, tap on your profile name/photo, and select \'Edit Profile\' to upload a new photo.
Can I change my assigned route?
Routes are assigned by the Administrator. Contact the transport office if you need a change in your route assignment.
